name: Control Cable, Inc.
old_description: Since 1975, we have been experts in the design and manufacture of cable products and assemblies, wire harnesses and connectivity solutions. Whether you require standard off-the-shelf cabling products or a custom manufactured solution, our extensive experience ensures that we can meet your every need.
about:
Control Cable, Inc. was established in 1975 in Windsor Mill, Maryland, along the Baltimore-Washington corridor. The company is a privately held, veteran-owned small business (VOSB) that began as a specialist in cable products and assemblies.

Today it manufactures custom and standard cable assemblies, wire harnesses, electromechanical box builds, and fiber optic cables, while also distributing thousands of off-the-shelf connectivity products, connectors, and components. The shop handles orders ranging from a single cable to production runs of hundreds of thousands, supported by an in-house engineering team that offers build-to-print and custom design services.

Its customer base spans end users, resellers, prime contractors, government agencies, and educational institutions across industries such as aerospace and defense, industrial equipment, transportation, solar, instrumentation, electronics, and gaming and entertainment.

The company emphasizes personal service, free design and technical support, and a quality program built on 100% inspection and testing that has yielded a return rate below one percent and a scrap rate under two percent. It also highlights its commitment to U.S. manufacturing.
